name: healthcare-dashboard
_comment: Scripts call node with a relative path instead of the .bin shims on purpose: this project lives under a directory containing '&', which cmd.exe treats as a command separator, so npm's generated vite.cmd truncates its own path and fails with 'Cannot find module C:\dev\Projects_HC\vite\bin\vite.js'. Relative paths keep the ampersand out of the command line.
